title: Transitivity of the structural dualizing counit
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-trf-admissibility], with $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $A=A_{E,n}$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be proper between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, let $a_Y:Y\to s$ and $a_X=a_Yf$ be the structure maps, and use their specified constructible exceptional adjunctions. Set $\omega_X=Ra_X^!A_s$ and $\omega_Y=Ra_Y^!A_s$ as in [def-trf-dualizing-complex]. Let $i_f:\omega_X\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf^!\omega_Y$ be the inverse of the canonical isomorphism of [thm-trf-dualizing-complex-composition], namely the component at $A_s$ of the conjugate exceptional composition comparison of [def-trf-admissibility]. Define
$$\tau_f=\varepsilon_{f,\omega_Y}\circ Rf_!i_f:Rf_*\omega_X=Rf_!\omega_X\longrightarrow\omega_Y,$$
and let $t_X:Ra_{X!}\omega_X\to A_s$, $t_Y:Ra_{Y!}\omega_Y\to A_s$ be the structure-adjunction counits. Then
$$t_Y\circ Ra_{Y!}\tau_f=t_X$$
as maps $Ra_{X!}\omega_X\to A_s$, after precomposing the left side with the specified compact-support composition isomorphism $Ra_{X!}\omega_X\cong Ra_{Y!}Rf_!\omega_X$.
